title: Beyond Fear: Disgust, Anger, and the Affective Core of Interpersonal Phobias.
summary: Interpersonal phobias-used here as an analytic label for enduring aversive orientations toward persons or groups, such as xenophobia, homophobia, transphobia, racism, and ageism-are often framed primarily as fear- or anxiety-driven. That view captures vigilance and avoidance, but it does not fully explain why such aversions are also expressed in the language of contamination, revulsion, exclusion, social cleansing, and sometimes violence. I argue that interpersonal phobias are better understood through a distinction among fear, anger, and disgust than through a fear-centered account alone. Fear is most relevant when the target is appraised as dangerous under uncertainty, thereby motivating vigilance, mitigation, and avoidance. Anger is most relevant when the target is appraised as obstructive yet changeable, thereby motivating confrontation, punishment, and aggression. Disgust is most relevant when the target is appraised as contaminating, offensive, or fundamentally incompatible and as unlikely to change, thereby motivating severance, exclusion, expulsion, and, in its most radical form, exterminative violence. To organize this argument, I apply the Interaction Discrepancy Model (IDM) as a theoretical extension. Holding accountability to the other constant, uncertainty should favor fear/anxiety and mitigative avoidance, whereas offensiveness combined with low perceived changeability should favor disgust and severance. Anger and disgust can co-occur, but they do different work: anger energizes attack, whereas disgust frames the target as something to remove altogether. I derive falsifiable predictions, outline experimental and experience-sampling designs, and discuss implications for intervention, including the limits of purely anxiety-reduction approaches and the need to target disgust, dehumanization, and appraisals of changeability.

标题：超越恐惧：厌恶、愤怒与人际恐惧症的情感核心
摘要：人际恐惧症——本文将其作为一个分析性标签，用于指代对他人或群体持久的厌恶倾向，例如仇外心理、同性恋恐惧、跨性别恐惧、种族主义和年龄歧视——通常被主要视为由恐惧或焦虑驱动。这种观点捕捉到了警觉和回避，但未能完全解释为何这些厌恶也以污染、反感、排斥、社会净化及有时暴力的语言来表达。我认为，相较于仅以恐惧为中心的解释，通过区分恐惧、愤怒和厌恶这三种情绪，能更好地理解人际恐惧症。当目标在不确定性下被评估为危险时，恐惧最为相关，从而激发警觉、缓解和回避。当目标被评估为具有阻碍性但可改变时，愤怒最为相关，从而激发对抗、惩罚和攻击。当目标被评估为具有污染性、冒犯性或根本不相容且不太可能改变时，厌恶最为相关，从而激发断绝关系、排斥、驱逐，以及在其最极端形式下的灭绝性暴力。为组织这一论点，我应用互动差异模型作为理论延伸。保持对他人责任不变的情况下，不确定性应偏向恐惧/焦虑和缓解性回避，而冒犯性与低感知可改变性相结合应偏向厌恶和断绝关系。愤怒和厌恶可以共存，但它们发挥不同作用：愤怒激发攻击，而厌恶则将目标视为需要完全移除的对象。我推导出可证伪的预测，概述了实验和经验采样设计，并讨论了对干预的启示，包括纯焦虑减轻方法的局限性以及针对厌恶、去人性化和可改变性评估的必要性。
关键词：人际恐惧症；厌恶；愤怒；恐惧；互动差异模型

title: Feasibility of Using Electronic Medical Records to Identify Postdischarge Mental Health Screening Documentation in Trauma Patients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Injury leads to long-term physical and mental health challenges, yet inpatient screening for post-traumatic stress disorder and depression remains inconsistent, and postdischarge mental health is poorly understood, particularly in less resourced trauma centers where emerging symptoms may go unrecognized.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the feasibility of using the electronic medical record to identify postdischarge mental health screening documentation in adult trauma patients within 6 months after discharge.
METHODS: This retrospective descriptive feasibility study was conducted at a midwestern US regional Level II trauma center serving a predominantly rural catchment area. Adult trauma patients admitted between January 1 and December 31, 2024, were eligible for inclusion. A stratified sampling strategy was used, selecting up to 4 records per month, with follow-up data collected for 6 months postdischarge.
RESULTS: The final sample included 48 patients with a median age of 67 (IQR: 18) years, predominantly male (n = 35, 73%), and White (n = 40, 83%). A total of 7 patients (15%) screened positive for post-traumatic stress disorder risk, depression risk, or both during inpatient admission. Trauma-related follow-up was documented in the electronic medical record for 37 patients (77%), with a median of 15 days (IQR: 16) to first follow-up appointment and a median of 2 provider contacts (IQR: 1) within 6 months of discharge. Despite this follow-up, only 1 of 37 patients (3%) with documented follow-up had a documented mental health screening during the postdischarge period.
CONCLUSION: This feasibility study found that the electronic medical record alone was insufficient to capture postdischarge mental health screening documentation, with only 1 screening identified across 37 patients with documented follow-up, highlighting a critical gap in care continuity that warrants further investigation.

标题：利用电子病历识别创伤患者出院后心理健康筛查记录的可行性研究  
摘要：背景：伤害会导致长期的身心健康挑战，但住院期间对创伤后应激障碍和抑郁症的筛查仍不一致，且出院后心理健康状况了解不足，尤其是在资源匮乏的创伤中心，新出现的症状可能未被识别。  
目的：评估利用电子病历识别成年创伤患者出院后6个月内心理健康筛查记录的可行性。  
方法：这项回顾性描述性可行性研究在美国中西部一个主要为农村地区服务的区域二级创伤中心进行。2024年1月1日至12月31日期间入院的成年创伤患者符合纳入条件。采用分层抽样策略，每月最多选择4份记录，并收集出院后6个月的随访数据。  
结果：最终样本包括48名患者，中位年龄为67岁（四分位距：18），主要为男性（n=35，73%）和白人（n=40，83%）。住院期间，共有7名患者（15%）筛查出创伤后应激障碍风险、抑郁风险或两者兼有。电子病历记录了37名患者（77%）的创伤相关随访，首次随访的中位时间为15天（四分位距：16），出院后6个月内平均有2次医疗服务接触（四分位距：1）。尽管有随访，但在有随访记录的37名患者中，仅有1名（3%）在出院后期间有记录的心理健康筛查。  
结论：这项可行性研究发现，仅靠电子病历不足以捕捉出院后的心理健康筛查记录，在37名有随访记录的患者中仅识别出1次筛查，这突显了护理连续性的关键缺口，值得进一步研究。  
关键词：心理健康筛查；创伤患者；出院后随访；电子病历；创伤后应激障碍

title: Exploring the effects of mindfulness meditation on resting-state functional connectivity: an overview.
summary: Mindfulness meditation has received growing interest in research over the past decades. Mindfulness meditation training (MMT) can be employed as a mental practice to improve cognitive skills such as attention and emotion regulation and may promote well-being. Neuroimaging studies have emerged to understand the effects of MMT on brain functioning. However, no review exists on the effects of MMT on resting-state brain functional connectivity (rsFC) in healthy meditation-naïve adults specifically. We, therefore, aimed to provide an overview of studies that investigated the effects of MMT on rsFC in healthy meditation-naïve adults, as well as their link to cognitive and clinical measures. Several studies reported changes in MMT-induced rsFC within and between regions of the default mode (DMN), salience (SN), and central executive (CEN) networks. Both increases and decreases in rsFC have been observed for brain regions associated with these networks after MMT, each with differential roles in emotion regulation, stress, and cognitive functions. Some studies highlighted associations between changes in rsFC after MMT and modifications in cognitive performance and psycho-affective measures, which may be influenced by MMT-specific characteristics such as practice duration or delivery methods. MMT may induce a reorganization in the brain's functional architecture by altering rsFC within and between these networks and seems to modify processes related to attention, executive memory, emotional regulation, stress, and resilience. Investigating functional connectivity during rest in key brain networks seems a promising approach to understand the effects of mindfulness meditation on overall well-being.

标题：正念冥想对静息态功能连接影响的综述
摘要：正念冥想在过去几十年中引起了研究领域的日益关注。正念冥想训练可作为一种心理练习，用于改善注意力和情绪调节等认知技能，并可能促进幸福感。神经影像学研究已开始揭示正念冥想训练对大脑功能的影响。然而，目前尚无针对健康无冥想经验成年人的正念冥想训练对静息态脑功能连接影响的综述。因此，我们旨在概述针对健康无冥想经验成年人中正念冥想训练对静息态功能连接影响的研究，及其与认知和临床指标的联系。多项研究报告了正念冥想训练诱导的默认模式网络、突显网络和中央执行网络内部及之间的静息态功能连接变化。在正念冥想训练后，这些网络相关脑区的静息态功能连接既有增强也有减弱，各自在情绪调节、压力和认知功能中发挥不同作用。部分研究强调了正念冥想训练后静息态功能连接变化与认知表现和心理-情感指标改变之间的关联，这可能受练习时长或实施方式等正念冥想训练特定特征的影响。正念冥想训练可能通过改变这些网络内部及之间的静息态功能连接，诱导大脑功能架构的重组，并似乎能改善与注意力、执行记忆、情绪调节、压力和韧性相关的加工过程。探究关键脑网络在静息态下的功能连接，似乎是一种理解正念冥想对整体幸福感影响的有前景的方法。
关键词：正念冥想；静息态功能连接；情绪调节；默认模式网络；认知功能

title: Distinct roles of NPTX1 and NPTX2 in synaptic transmission of the fear memory engrams in the dentate gyrus.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The synaptic transmission of memory engrams is important for their roles in memory storage and retrieval, and can be regulated by multiple neuronal adhesion molecules. This study focuses on the roles of neuronal pentraxin (NPTX) family members (NPTX1 and NPTX2), which are biomarkers for cognitive decline, in the synaptic transmission of Fos-(F-RAM) and Npas4-(N-RAM)-dependent engrams formed during contextual fear conditioning in the dentate gyrus.
METHODS: Utilizing robust activity marking (RAM) system, contextual fear conditioning, conditional knockout (cKO) technology and electrophysiological recording, we analyzed the characteristic of miniature excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic currents (mEPSCs and mIPSCs) in engram cells of wild-type and Nptxs cKO mice.
RESULTS: Nptx1 cKO leads to an increased amplitude and frequency of mEPSCs and decreased amplitude of mIPSCs in F-RAM neurons, as well as an elevated mEPSC frequency and reduced mIPSC frequency in N-RAM neurons. In contrast, Nptx2 cKO results in a decreased mEPSC frequency and increased mIPSC frequency in both F-RAM and N-RAM neurons.
CONCLUSION: Nptx1 cKO increased engram activity while Nptx2 cKO decreased engram activity. These findings reveal the distinct roles of the NPTX family in regulating the synaptic transmission of the fear engrams.

标题：NPTX1和NPTX2在齿状回恐惧记忆印迹突触传递中的不同作用
摘要：背景：记忆印迹的突触传递对其在记忆存储和提取中的作用至关重要，并且可由多种神经元黏附分子调控。本研究聚焦于作为认知衰退生物标志物的神经元正五聚蛋白（NPTX）家族成员（NPTX1和NPTX2）在齿状回情境恐惧条件化过程中形成的Fos依赖（F-RAM）和Npas4依赖（N-RAM）印迹突触传递中的作用。方法：利用鲁棒活性标记（RAM）系统、情境恐惧条件化、条件性基因敲除（cKO）技术和电生理记录，我们分析了野生型和Nptxs cKO小鼠印迹细胞中微小兴奋性和抑制性突触后电流（mEPSCs和mIPSCs）的特征。结果：Nptx1 cKO导致F-RAM神经元中mEPSC的幅值和频率增加，mIPSC的幅值降低，同时N-RAM神经元中mEPSC频率升高而mIPSC频率降低。相反，Nptx2 cKO导致F-RAM和N-RAM神经元中mEPSC频率降低，mIPSC频率升高。结论：Nptx1 cKO增加了印迹活性，而Nptx2 cKO降低了印迹活性。这些发现揭示了NPTX家族在调节恐惧印迹突触传递中的不同作用。
关键词：恐惧记忆印迹；突触传递；神经元正五聚蛋白；齿状回；情境恐惧条件化
